integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Top-down view of a kraft-paper craft table under a warm desk-lamp, 9:16 vertical frame. A pair of human animator hands enters in stop-motion increments and places a large black cardboard sheet as the background. Hands then layer black floral paper cutouts, crepe-paper petals with gold-glitter edges, and small paper leaves onto the board; visible cardboard corrugation, glue tabs, creases, and physical shadows from the lamp. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, low 45-degree angle. Individual cream-colored cardboard letters with black drop-shadow sides slide along paper tracks into position, spelling <d>Qwen3.8 Max å¼æºï¼</d> in layered 3D paper type; each letter lands with a tiny paper-dust puff. Small gold circular paper tokens stamped <d>Token</d> tumble from above and stack in a small pile. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, medium close-up of a cardboard pull-tab mechanism. A paper slider pulls out, revealing large foam-core-backed letters spelling <d>100äº¿Token</d> popping forward in three stop-motion stages; numbers show visible paper thickness, beveled edges, and matte cream surface. Camera slowly dollies in. [Shot 4] At 00:06.000, eye-level view. A jointed paper-puppet woman made of black crepe-paper dress, tissue-paper floral headdress with gold bead details, painted paper skin, and black yarn hair rises from below frame. Stop-motion joints at elbows and neck click into place; she turns toward camera. [Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the composition settles into the exact framing of <Picture 1>. The woman raises her right index finger to her lips in a two-frame stop-motion shush gesture. The final text <d>åè´¹é¢ï¼</d> pops in as cream 3D cardboard letters beneath <d>100äº¿Token</d>. Camera holds steady with shallow paper-diorama depth of field. At 10.000 seconds the frame is identical to <Picture 1>: dark floral paper background, promotional Chinese text, and the paper woman with finger to lips surrounded by gold-glitter paper flowers. No plastic texture, no smooth CG surfaces, no meaningless text, no structural interpenetration; all motion obeys real cardboard stiffness and stop-motion step size.

overall_soundscape: Soft paper rustling, scissors snips, glue-stick squelches, cardboard thuds as letters land, tiny paper-token clinks, stop-motion frame-advance clicks, and the faint scrape of the pull-tab mechanism.

non_diegetic_music: Light curious stop-motion plucked strings and glockenspiel, building in tempo toward a bright brass-and-string stinger at the 00:08.000 final reveal, then holding a sustained chord into silence by 10.000 seconds.
